description.value: Walmart Supercentre Store #3019 is a large-format department and grocery store serving east Abbotsford, stocking a full range of food staples alongside electronics, clothing, and general merchandise. For a touring cyclist it serves as a one-stop resupply point with accessible washrooms and free in-store Wi-Fi. The store is wheelchair accessible throughout.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 29m. Total: 7 spaces.
